description: Prepare an unsigned MagicBlock deposit, private transfer, or withdrawal for a local wallet to inspect and sign. Call this after privatepay_checkout and before wallet authorization; PrivateDAO never receives a private key and this tool never broadcasts.

inputSchema.description: Prepare an unsigned MagicBlock deposit, private transfer, or withdrawal for local wallet inspection and signing. PrivateDAO never receives a private key and this tool never broadcasts.

gasless.description: Request the configured sponsored route when supported; the wallet still signs the returned transaction.

owner.description: Optional destination or balance owner public key.

payer.description: Wallet public key that will inspect and authorize the transaction.

phase.description: Unsigned wallet operation to prepare after the challenge: deposit into the private rail, private transfer, or withdrawal.

request_id.description: PrivatePAY request identifier returned by the challenge or checkout.

split.description: Optional private transfer split count, from one to fifteen.

name: privatepay_prepare

outputSchema.description: Unsigned PrivatePAY preparation context for local wallet authorization.

request_id.description: PrivatePAY request identifier bound to the unsigned operation.

required_signers.description: Wallet public keys that must sign locally.

transaction.description: Serialized unsigned transaction when the provider returns one.

title: PrivateDAO Payment Preparation
